name: Check Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - 'r/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
    - 'r/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-[0-9a-zA-Z]+'

jobs:
  check-version:
    name: check-version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Get the release version from the branch
      if: env.VERSION == ''
      run: |
        VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}
        VERSION=${VERSION##r/}
        echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    - name: Show the version
      run: |
        echo "version is: $VERSION"
    - name: Check that tag version and Cargo.toml version are the same
      shell: bash
      run: |
        if ! grep -q "version = \"$VERSION\"" Cargo.toml; then
          echo "version does not match Cargo.toml" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
    outputs:
      version: ${{ env.VERSION }}

  check-release:
    name: check-release
    needs: ['check-version']
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      # Emit backtraces on panics.
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED: on
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        tool: [arx, tar2arx, zip2arx]
        build: [linux, macos, windows]
        include:
        - build: linux
          os: ubuntu-latest
        - build: macos
          os: macos-latest
        - build: windows
          os: windows-latest

    steps:
    - name: Install dependencies
      if: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' }}
      run: |
        sudo apt-get install -y libfuse-dev

    - name: Install dependencies
      if: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest'}}
      run: |
        brew install macfuse pkgconf

    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup cache
      uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cargo/bin/
          ~/.cargo/.crates.toml
          ~/.cargo/.crates2.json
          ~/.cargo/registry/index/
          ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
          ~/.cargo/git/db/
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-stable-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

    - name: Run sccache-cache
      uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9

    - name: Install Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

    - name: Build release binary
      shell: bash
      run: |
        cargo build --verbose --release -p ${{ matrix.tool }}
        if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "windows-latest" ]; then
          bin="target/release/${{ matrix.tool }}.exe"
        else
          bin="target/release/${{ matrix.tool }}"
        fi
        echo "BIN=$bin" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Strip release binary (macos)
      if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
      shell: bash
      run: strip "$BIN"

    - name: Determine archive name
      shell: bash
      run: |
        version="${{ needs.check-version.outputs.version }}"
        echo "ARCHIVE=${{ matrix.tool }}-$version-${{ matrix.build }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Creating directory for archive
      shell: bash
      run: |
        mkdir -p "$ARCHIVE"/{complete,doc}
        cp "$BIN" "$ARCHIVE"/
        cp {README.md,LICENSE-MIT} "$ARCHIVE"/
        cp Changelog.md "$ARCHIVE"/doc/

    - name: Generate completions
      shell: bash
      run: |
        "$BIN" --version
        "$BIN" --generate-complete=bash > "$ARCHIVE/complete/${{ matrix.tool }}.bash"
        "$BIN" --generate-complete=fish > "$ARCHIVE/complete/${{ matrix.tool }}.fish"
        "$BIN" --generate-complete=powershell > "$ARCHIVE/complete/_${{ matrix.tool }}.ps1"
        "$BIN" --generate-complete

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
